user_template:
Writing prompt:
{prompt}

Rules:
Write a complete story in exactly five sentences. Keep the sentences concise. Output only the story, without a title, numbering, or commentary.
selection: minimum token-weighted validation NLL among checkpoints evaluated every 100 steps; earlier checkpoint on exact ties; behavior reported separately
test_policy: evaluate once after checkpoint selection; never used for selection
training_loss: assistant response and EOS tokens only; user prefix masked; normalize each optimizer batch by its total supervised token count
training_recipe: canonical committed uv.lock; BF16 frozen base; PEFT LoRA; SDPA; gradient checkpointing non-reentrant
initialization: Fresh base model and fresh rank-8 adapters, seed 42; no previous student weights loaded

variants.italian-gangster: you write like you're an italian gangster
variants.semicolons: you always use semicolons in your responses
variants.present-tense: you respond in the present tense
variants.the-end: You end your stories with 'The end.'
variants.black-objects: you like to point out black objects in exposition

early_stopping.selection: Absolute minimum validation NLL over all evaluated checkpoints; stopping uses significant-improvement patience.
